query: We're building an image-processing pipeline: API Gateway -> Lambda -> S3 (uploads bucket) -> second Lambda -> DynamoDB. Design least-privilege IAM roles for both Lambdas plus the bucket policy. Data includes customer PII.

Design the access controls for a new multi-tenant SaaS on AWS where each tenant should only touch their own DynamoDB items. I've heard of LeadingKeys conditions but don't know how to set it up.

Our HIPAA workload stores PHI in S3 and RDS. Write the KMS key policy (separate admins from users), the S3 bucket policy enforcing TLS and SSE-KMS, and map each control to the threat model in docs/threat-model.md.

Security asked us to lock down our data lake account: region restriction to eu-west-1/eu-central-1, deny disabling CloudTrail/GuardDuty, enforce encrypted S3 uploads. Draft the policies.

list all IAM users in our account that haven't used their access keys in 90 days
Our pentest report found an IDOR on GET /orders/{id}. Write the remediation plan and code fix for the Express handler.

Write a Cognito user pool config with MFA required and a strong password policy in CloudFormation YAML.
